reason: A settings utility for listing installed third-party dsh plugins and persistently enabling or disabling eligible plugins through profile patch configuration.

summaries.zh: 在 dsh 设置页管理已安装的第三方插件，并通过 profile 补丁配置持久启用或禁用符合条件的插件。
summaries.en: Manage installed third-party dsh plugins from the settings page and persistently enable or disable eligible plugins through profile patch configuration.

capabilities: Provides a settings-page interface for plugin state management
Reads and updates profile cordis.patch.yml entries to persist enabled or disabled states
Exposes documented HTTP routes for listing plugins and changing enabled state
